findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - retrying land after a native worker exhausts its model quota after the empty Before coding commit.
This previously reported retry still fails when the coordinator hands back the worker's quota-error message. `src/forge/native.py:286` records every handback as completed at the current HEAD, and `src/forge/land.py:93` suppresses another build when that record matches HEAD. Thus, even though this change ignores the empty commit, land goes straight to close, which refuses the ideas-only fix instead of restarting the worker.
